name: rx-index
check: cd ./app/static && for i in mode pause conn tiles meter jobs parallel q filter folders detail detail-close detail-json; do grep -q "id=\"$i\"" index.html || echo "error: index.html: missing id $i"; done | tee /dev/stderr | grep -q error && exit 1; grep -q '/static/app.js' index.html && grep -q '/static/style.css' index.html

name: rx-css
check: cd ./app/static && grep -q 'prefers-color-scheme: light' style.css && grep -q '#0c0917' style.css && grep -q 'focus-visible' style.css && grep -q 'prefers-reduced-motion' style.css && ! grep -qi 'color: *#fff\b' style.css

name: rx-appjs
check: cd ./app/static && node --check app.js && ! grep -n 'innerHTML *=.*\(name\|folder\|path\)' app.js && grep -q '/api/status' app.js && grep -q '/api/folder' app.js
